distinctions.identity: Giant Lobster and Lobster King are different stable items. Never merge them or translate IDs.
distinctions.original_names: Original skills, professions, NPCs and items use the game's current localized display names where available; this glossary does not override them.
distinctions.luck: Daily luck is distinct from luck skill/buff level. Keep 0.125, 13 and local slots 14 as separate displayed concepts.
distinctions.critical: Critical chance is not critical damage. Native critical points are not literal percentage points; preserve the supplied explanatory scale.
distinctions.speed: Movement speed and effective melee weapon speed are distinct.
distinctions.clock: Calendar game day = 1440 calendar minutes for machine cycles. Rescue seconds and lobster dinner seconds are real-time units. Rice bowl/sashimi use world-clock minutes.
distinctions.afk: Chest search is the player's centered 3×3 area, not a radius of three or nine tiles. Invalid cells do not disable valid neighboring chests.
distinctions.support: Vietnamese vi resources require a compatible additional-language pack with locale vi and fonts; no pack is included or tested. All non-English additions are initial translations, not independently native-reviewed.
